The development team behind this application consists of Information Technology students committed to building accessible, privacy-focused mobile solutions. Every member contributed specialized skills across mobile UI design, optical character recognition integration, local encrypted storage, and precise schedule notifications. Working collaboratively through every stage of development, the team prioritized user data protection by engineering a complete offline system that processes and stores sensitive medication schedules entirely on your device.

Android often stops background apps to save battery. Follow these steps to ensure your medication alarms always ring.
Required to show you reminders and alerts when it\'s time to take your medicine.
Allow the app to run without restrictions. This prevents the system from \'killing\' your alarms.
Ensure the app can start itself after your phone restarts or when an alarm is due.
Needed to deliver notifications at the exact second they are due.
Your alarms may not ring due to system restrictions. Follow our guide to ensure you never miss a dose.
Schedule a test alarm to fire in 5 seconds. This confirms that all permissions are working correctly.
Some critical permissions are missing. Your alarms may not ring unless you complete the setup guide.
Are you sure you want to delete %1$s? This will also cancel all scheduled reminders for it.
Allows the app to access alarm ringtones and custom audio files so your reminder plays out loud.
Allows full-screen alarm popups to appear over locked screens or when the app is closed.
Turn OFF \"Pause app activity if unused\" (or \"Remove permissions if app isn\'t used\") so Android won\'t hibernate the app or reset your permissions when unused.
